build_clip_embedding_model: build a CLIP embedding model with text and vision transformers for multimodal feature extraction
create_clip_text_features: create text features from input ids using the CLIP text transformer with position embeddings
create_clip_image_features: create image features from pixel values using the CLIP vision transformer with patch embeddings
test_clip_multimodal_processor: test the CLIP multimodal processor that handles image-only or text-only input validation and prompt replacement
review_clip_encoder_layer: review the CLIP encoder layer with self-attention and MLP blocks using pre-layer normalization
